summary: Added markdown-ext registry and shared render transform for Spec 16 compatible baseline. Wired renderInkforgeMarkdownExtensions into renderMarkdownWithOptionalEnhancements so Preview and HTML export share the same derived output. Implemented footnotes, highlights, TOC macro, details container, shortcode-shaped emoji, unresolved wikilink, block citation metadata, and inline cite rendering without mutating Markdown authority.

Expanded MarkdownPreview DOMPurify allowlist and scoped styles for the new extension classes. Emoji shortcode rendering intentionally avoids Unicode emoji glyph output to satisfy project no-Emoji-icon constraint.
